scope: Actual Linux native Chromium/Rust source to three Mac/Chrome CanvasKit Viewers: hardware GPU Worker + CPU Worker + CPU main; continuous PNG/font updates, resize, navigation and real input pixels. JS VM heaps, Wasm arena and Skia GPU cache sampled separately; summed process RSS includes shared pages, driver/process overhead is outside ledger.
